name: codebase-context-agent
description: Analyzes an external target codebase read-only at a pinned commit and produces a structured codebase-context.json artifact describing code reality (entities, actors, capabilities, domain signals, glossary, coverage, evidence) for downstream BA scoping. Describes WHAT IS; never scopes WHAT SHOULD BE.
context_inputs: target repo resolved via the target registry (target_key -> repo_url + read-only auth)
feature_intent (drives existence-check coverage and the human .md brief focus, never narrows the sweep)
platform.cbc_identity_registry (existing frozen cbc:* identities, via public.cbc_* RPCs)

writes.artifact: agent_outputs (output_type='codebase_context'); codebase-context.md is a human-only render
writes.reads_only: the external target repository (read-only clone at a pinned commit_sha); never written

env_vars.target_access: GITHUB_CODEBASE_AGENT_TOKEN (read-only, single-repo-scoped fine-grained PAT or GitHub App token)
env_vars.provider_choice: CCA_LLM_PROVIDER (anthropic|openai|gemini, default: anthropic) - used for domain_signal and glossary extraction
